_comment: Site registry per docs/03. Deployment records are REQUIRED before project-sensor ingest (docs/06 registry gate). window_local values below are from the reviewed Tidbit deployment; verify before first real run. series_map keys are the sensor name as it appears in the vendor file header ('Tidbit 1 , degF' -> 'Tidbit 1'), not the full column label; values are controlled parameter names from parameters.json.

deployments.notes: Position unverified - conflicting reports ~1-2 km apart. Leave lat/lon null until a GPS fix from the placer. Do NOT fill from memory or nearby station coords.

sites.name: La Jolla shore station (NDBC)
sites.notes: Sensor geometry from the NDBC station page, retrieved 2026-08-25: sea temp depth 3.4 m below MLLW; air temp 7.2 m and anemometer 8.2 m above a site elevation of 9.3 m above MSL. The 3.4 m intake is why depth_m is recorded per parameter - comparing it to a logger at another depth is the error docs/02 says to prevent structurally. NOT an independent station from COOPS:9410230: the NDBC station page titles this platform 'LJAC1 - 9410230 - La Jolla, CA', owned by NOAA NOS. NDBC redistributes the NOS observations, so the two site records describe one instrument package and must never both count as neighbors for the same validation.

sites.name: La Jolla (Scripps Pier) tide station
sites.notes: Same NOS platform as NDBC:LJAC1 - see that record. Water level here is the product CO-OPS serves with an explicit datum (MLLW, docs/03); NDBC's TIDE column for the same platform declares no datum and is deliberately not ingested.
